===== BEGIN EXACT RESPONSE =====
**I have not determined the exact threshold. I did construct and rigorously certify a larger positive-capacity region:**
\[
\boxed{0.413<x_*\le \frac12.}
\]

For **every finite \(E>0\)**, the construction proves
\[
Q_E(\mathcal N_x)>0\qquad(0<x\le 0.413),
\]
and finite-witness continuity extends positivity into a further neighbourhood above \(0.413\). The accepted antidegradability theorem proves
\[
Q_E(\mathcal N_x)=0\qquad(x\ge\tfrac12),
\]
including the boundary, against arbitrary correlated non-Gaussian encodings. **The exact location of \(x_*\) inside the remaining interval is unresolved.**

There is also a complete structural result: the receiver–environment **purity ordering has its exact boundary at \(x=1/2\), for every block length and every mixed input**. I prove below why this does not, by itself, establish the corresponding quantum-capacity boundary.

The supplied GKP paper’s bound \(1/e\le x_*\le1/2\) and its decoder-specific results are credited under their stated scope. The positive witnesses here are finite-Fock constructions; they do not infer an arbitrary-code threshold from a GKP decoder threshold. [arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/html/2411.04277v2?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

The inputs are rank-two mixtures
\[
\rho=p|u\rangle\langle u|+(1-p)|v\rangle\langle v|,
\]
where
\[
|u\rangle=\frac{\sum_j e_j|4j\rangle}{\sqrt{\sum_j e_j^2}},
\qquad
|v\rangle=\frac{\sum_j o_j|4j+1\rangle}{\sqrt{\sum_j o_j^2}}.
\]

The coefficients \(e_j,o_j\) are **integers**, and \(p\) is rational. Their finite photon support is exact. Numerical optimization proposes candidates; integer rounding then defines an exact state whose coherent information is checked separately.

\qquad
p=\frac{169295579159}{500000000000},

## 1. A quantitative limitation on degradable-extension converses

I derived a positive capacity floor for **every degradable extension of the fixed single-use channel**, with arbitrary separable receiver and environment spaces.

Let \(M\) be degradable, with the same one-mode input and photon-number observable as \(\mathcal N_x\), and suppose
\[
\mathcal N_x=L\circ M
\]
for some receiver postprocessing \(L\). For \(x<1/2\), choose a finite integer \(J\) such that
\[
c_{J,x}
=
1-\left(1+\frac{J}{1+x}\right)
  \left(\frac{x}{1+x}\right)^J

\frac12+x.
\]
Define
\[
G_{J,x}=2c_{J,x}(2c_{J,x}-1-2x),
\qquad
w_{J,x}
=
\frac{G_{J,x}}{8J+16c_{J,x}\sqrt J}.
\]
